config.channel.name: Announcement channel
config.channel.description: Channel where member anniversaries are announced, and the server's anniversary unless it has its own. Unset: member anniversaries are not announced.
config.serverChannel.name: Server anniversary channel
config.serverChannel.description: Channel where the server's anniversary is announced. Unset: the announcement channel.
config.timeZone.name: Time zone
config.timeZone.description: Time zone the server's days follow.
config.hour.name: Announcement hour
config.hour.description: Hour of the day (0 to 23) when the announcements are posted.
config.memberAnniversaries.name: Member anniversaries
config.memberAnniversaries.description: Announce the members who have been on the server for another full year.
config.serverAnniversary.name: Server anniversary
config.serverAnniversary.description: Announce the anniversary of the server's creation.
config.loopCard.name: Loop the cards
config.loopCard.description: Replay the animated cards (member and server anniversaries) forever, resting on the landed confetti between two throws. Off: they play once.
members.heading: 🎉 **Anniversaries on the server**
serverCard.subtitle: Thank you for being part of it 🎉
admin.recompute.corrected: {{user}}'s seniority now counts from {{since}}, before their current arrival on {{joined}}. Their next anniversaries take it into account.
admin.recompute.correctedPartial: {{user}}'s seniority now counts from {{since}}, before their current arrival on {{joined}}. Discord is still indexing the server's old history, which can take hours on a large server: run the command again later, an older message may turn up.
admin.recompute.unchanged: {{user}}'s seniority counts from their arrival on {{joined}}: none of their messages the bot can read on the server is older.
admin.recompute.notMember: {{user}} is not a member of the server: their seniority can only be recomputed while they are here.
admin.recompute.bot: Bots are not celebrated: nothing to recompute for {{user}}.
admin.recompute.notReady: Discord is still indexing the server's messages: try again later. On a large server, indexing the old history can take hours.
admin.recompute.noAccess: Discord refuses the bot the message search: it needs Message Content access, to enable in Discord's Developer Portal, and permission to read the channels. Retrying will not help until that is set.
admin.recompute.failed: Recomputing {{user}}'s seniority failed: try again later.
uninstall.warning_one: One member's recomputed seniority will be deleted: it will have to be recomputed again.
uninstall.warning_other: The recomputed seniority of {{count}} members will be deleted: it will have to be recomputed again.
